title: Indicator after adding a query
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that it does not specify and a value $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$. For every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the indicator of the set agreeing with the path after adding the requirement $x_i=b$ equals the original indicator at $x$ if $x_i=b$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate not already specified by the path
